issues.description: The problem statement specifies that the color parameter for set_pixel is passed in ECX, but the solution implementation writes the pixel using EDX (instruction: mov [eax], edx). This is a parameter/register mismatch between the specification and the provided solution and will confuse students about which register holds the color value when implementing or testing set_pixel.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution's set_pixel implementation to use ECX as the color input when writing to memory (e.g., mov dword [eax], ecx) and ensure the address is correctly in EAX (or move the final address into the register used by the store). Also document in the template that ECX is the color input to avoid ambiguity.
